title: IDAIM Google Sheets schema
description: Single source of truth for the DATA V2 spreadsheet contract, shared by the Python ML pipeline (idaim-pipeline) and the Next.js web app (idaim-web). Column order matters: gspread append_rows and the Sheets API write by header name, but the Python scripts build rows positionally, so a reorder here is a breaking change for both sides.
note: The 'cells' tab is intentionally absent. Its lat/lon are SWAPPED (data import bug). Cell geometry comes from data/cells_full.parquet, exported to public/cells.geojson. Never read lat/lon from the Sheets 'cells' tab.

sampling_initiation.description: One row per trap installation. Links to watch_list via cell_id and to lab_results via trap_id.

columns.name: state
columns.note: State machine: trap installed -> closed. Lab results are only accepted when state='closed'.

trap_checks.description: Field check visits. Multiple rows per trap_id.

lab_results.description: Laboratory identification results. Gated: only traps whose sampling_initiation.state == 'closed' may receive a lab result.

columns.name: sampling_lab_id
columns.note: Auto-generated, links to the sampling episode.

watch_list.description: Ranked output of the weekly retrain. Written only by train_local.py. The web app reads it; only the admin page may toggle 'visited'.

columns.name: threshold_used
columns.note: Global default 0.10; per-district tuning in production.

columns.name: trap_id
columns.note: Set once the watch-list cell is sampled.

users.description: Legacy auth store. Superseded by schema_idaim.users in Vercel Postgres (bcrypt) during the Next.js migration. Retained for the Streamlit app until cutover.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.note: SHA256 in the Streamlit era; bcrypt in the web app.

features_active.description: Read-only mirror of features_cache_active.parquet (36,905 cells x 60 dynamic features), written by push_features_to_sheets.py. Exists for inspection only. The app does not read this tab at runtime.
features_active.columns: cell_id, lat, lon, district, then 5 features x 12 months in June-May cycle order (LST_06, NDVI_06, Humidity_06, Precip_06, WindSpeed_06, ... LST_05, NDVI_05, Humidity_05, Precip_05, WindSpeed_05)
